messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions. Let me verify your identity first, and then I'll look up your prescriptions and the Lakeview store. Good news—you're already set up at the Harbor on Main Street in Lakeview, and that's your home store. But I'm not seeing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions at Brightway that you'd like us to request, or are your prescriptions already here?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah, they're at the Brightway, not with you guys yet. Albuterol and... Zoloft.
AGENT: Got it. I need to reach out to Brightway to request those transfers. To do that, I'll need the store location or ID for the Brightway in Columbus. Do you happen to know the address or store number?
CALLER: The Brightway on High Street, I think. Oh, and the Zoloft - the sertraline, same thing.
AGENT: Perfect. Let me find that Brightway location for you. I'm not finding a Brightway on High Street in Columbus in our system. Can you double-check the street name or the pharmacy name? That way I can request the transfer from the right location.  [system actions: find_stores]
CALLER: I don't know the address, it's the one in Columbus. Can't you look it up?
AGENT (LATEST): I can only search our transfer system for pharmacies we work with. Since I'm not finding that Brightway location, it may not be in our network, or the address might be slightly different. Here's what I can do: you can call that Brightway directly and ask them to transfer your Albuterol and Zoloft to Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview. They'll have your prescriptions and can send them over. Does that work for you?

CONDITIONS:
move_2: the agent starts or confirms transferring the albuterol; or, failing that, before the final read-back
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Old store phone might be 614-555-0199 (recognizes it if read to him)"
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Phone 555-0177"
stop_0: Agent gives a final read-back of sertraline only, B-4471 to H-302, and confirms the transfer has been requested.
stop_2: Agent says the transfer could not be done and gives a next step.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never starts or confirms transferring albuterol."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask about old store phone number."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask about a phone number."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No read-back or confirmation of transfer occurred."}, "stop_2": {"met": true, "why": "Agent says transfer can't be done here, suggests calling Brightway directly."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
